title.narrative: Inclusive communities: increasing access to rights and participation of people

description.narrative: The ‘Inclusive Communities: increasing access to rights and participation of people with disabilities on personal, community and societal levels, in Kenya and Zimbabwe’ project aims to increase access to rights and participation of people with disabilities on personal, community and societal levels, together with implementing partners REPSSI and BNBR Kenya. The objectives of the project are to strengthen organisations of people with disabilities to raise awareness, reduce disability stigma and advocate for systemic change. The objectives of the grant are to improve access to education, peer support, health services and livelihood opportunities through community-based inclusive development, improving resilience to emergencies. The project will create sustainable change in how disability and mental health is perceived by people with disabilities, their communities and government institutions. The key activities include participatory mapping, capacity building, awareness raising and advocacy, networking and sharing, and learning and accountability. This will be done through providing access to capital, opportunities for employment, and jointly engaging with the public and private sectors in policy reform and networking and coordination mechanisms established through the project. The project will also build the capacity of primary health care and education providers to identify people, including children with disabilities, to provide necessary support and access to services.
